newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragonfield debuts at HK$1.40/share.
newsitem.headline: Dragonfield debuts at HK$1.40/share.

text.p: Shares of leather garments manufacturer Dragonfield Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$1.40 on Thursday, compared with their issue price of HK$1.00.
Dragonfield offered 90 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in a public offering in Hong Kong. The 81 million shares available for public subscription were 67.6 times subscribed.
The company has a sales and distribution network of 150 outlets throughout China.

It said the net proceeds would be used to fund expansion of production facilities, to set up showrooms and offices in China and Eastern Europe, and to increase processing capacity of dry cleaning services.
